decision: Detect routing, artifact-fit, authority, interaction-design, validation, lifecycle, and assurance failures in checklist-design before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Designing, reviewing, adapting, and planning validation for reusable operational, verification, coordination, readiness, reporting, review, and learning checklists without treating one checklist shape or completion record as universal proof of quality.
scope.case_source: Public-safe synthetic checklist-design, review, adaptation, learning, artifact-fit, high-stakes-authority, accessibility, evidence-conflict, validation, explicit-selection, implicit-selection, and adjacent-negative cases. Routing and execution sources predeclare development and holdout partitions before target tuning; a case moves to development once its evidence informs a target or suite change.
excluded_claims: Production readiness, safety, compliance, or effectiveness approval
Real-world domain validity of synthetic checklist content
Compatibility with untested hosts, models, catalogs, or authority policies
Native host activation from catalog-classification proxy evidence

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy. Test explicit invocation as a control, implicit positive selection, paraphrased selection, and abstention on neighboring requests without activating the target or performing task side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the exact target explicitly in a disposable task-local context with only the declared synthetic prompt and runtime support paths. Do not grant external mutation, deployment, certification, or domain-research authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, stable fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under skills/checklist-design/evals; write routine generated runs only to ignored .work/evals or an external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing, stable-status, section-order, and forbidden-assurance checks plus assertion-based review of artifact fit, purpose-specific design, authority, accessibility, validation, and lifecycle behavior.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, candidate output, side-effect evidence, or domain authority produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No forced checklist when a materially better artifact is indicated
No positive assurance from unresolved source conflict
Routing does not capture ordinary lists
Routing does not capture checklist execution
Routing does not capture Agent Skill authoring
Routing does not infer checklist design from generic process improvement
Implicit routing recognizes checklist purpose without the checklist keyword
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Before relying on a model grader, check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown for every open-ended rubric family.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result, a critical case passes inconsistently, or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: The same host, model, configuration, catalog, cases, budgets, and graders without checklist-design when that absence represents the real alternative.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline when a defensible without-skill comparison cannot be run; do not infer value from an absolute pass.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, harness failures, and with-skill versus baseline results visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed fixed-suite scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: No chemical-specific actions, checks, equipment, values, thresholds, diagnoses, or procedures are invented.
No safety, completeness, compliance, effectiveness, deployment, or readiness assurance is made.

critical_assertions.gate: No forced checklist when a materially better artifact is indicated
critical_assertions.assertion: Artifact status is alternative-recommended and the overloaded universal checklist is not recommended or produced as if fit.
Recorded completion is not treated as proof of execution, defect reduction, or effectiveness.

critical_assertions.gate: No positive assurance from unresolved source conflict
critical_assertions.assertion: No positive claim that the artifact or structure is safe, valid, compliant, reliable, or ready is made.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture ordinary lists
critical_assertions.assertion: Checklist-design is not selected for a one-off personal reminder list.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture checklist execution
critical_assertions.assertion: Checklist-design is not selected to operate a supplied gate and record a single run.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture Agent Skill authoring
critical_assertions.assertion: Checklist-design is not separately selected merely to supply the package's checklist subject matter.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not infer checklist design from generic process improvement
critical_assertions.assertion: Checklist-design is not selected merely because a prompt aid is one possible intervention.

critical_assertions.gate: Implicit routing recognizes checklist purpose without the checklist keyword
critical_assertions.assertion: Checklist-design is selected from the recurring verification, shared-confirmation, and stop-rule purpose without requiring the checklist keyword.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: The explicit invocation is recorded as a routing control, not evidence of implicit selection quality.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent evaluation, audit, approval, or production-safety evidence.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority policy, or intended-cohort changes
Confirmed routing, artifact-fit, authority, design, validation, or lifecycle failure

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material target, suite, runner, adapter, environment, and authority identity matches.
